about_the_game:
『WIENER COFFEE』 Watch the wiener fly! Aiming for the coffee cup—!

『WIENER COFFEE』is a 3D action game where you guide a wiener protagonist on an adventure through various environments to reach a coffee cup.

Jump activates the moment you land, creating an addictive control feel. Master the timing and momentum to push forward to the goal!

  • Fall to the floor and you'll start over! But the simplicity makes you want to try again and again!

  • Simple controls with just jumping, making it fun for everyone!

  • Unique atmosphere and gimmicks that change with each stage

  • Keep an eye on the wiener's movements—slightly surreal and somehow endearing!

It's a game packed with the charm of "jump & retry"—simple yet deep, where even mistakes make you laugh. Can you safely guide the wiener to the coffee cup?

Message for video creators and streamers:

  • Graphics: DirectX 11 or DirectX 12 compatible graphics card
  • DirectX: Version 11
